fields.Name: ORD-06 - Subscription Renewal
fields.Description: Orders.SpawnRenewals end to end (SR1-SR11, D55) — the scheduled job that continues a subscription past its term. Because it runs unattended against live customers, most checks assert what it must NOT do: not renew outside the lead window, not renew when AutoRenew is off, not renew a canceled subscription, and above all not renew twice. Also covers the contiguous term append, booking and recognition over the new window, the IsRenewal bypass that lets a RejectDuplicate type renew itself, the subscription-level RenewalLeadDays override, Preview, and the RenewsSubscriptionID / SubscriptionEvent audit trail.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: One confirmed renewal order inside the lead window, appending a contiguous term 2 that books 1200 and recognizes 12 monthly slices dated into its own window; zero placed when outside the window, AutoRenew off, or canceled; a second pass places nothing; a RejectDuplicate type still renews; a 90-day subscription override fires at 60 days out; Preview writes nothing.
